title: Nonexistence of finite-time blow-up for the equivariant harmonic map heat flow from $B^2$ to $S^2$
summary: We consider $D$-equivariant solutions to the harmonic map heat flow from $B^2$ to $S^2$ under general time-dependent smooth boundary data and prove that there is no finite-time blow-up when $D \geq 2$.
